questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days while B and C together can complete the same work in 15 days. If A is 50% more efficient than C, then in how many days will A alone complete the work?

options.explanation: Incorrect calculation of A's efficiency.
Incorrect calculation of A's efficiency.
Correct calculation of A's efficiency.
Incorrect calculation of A's efficiency.

questions.explanation: Let A’s efficiency be 3x units/day (50% more than C, so C = 2x). A + B = 1/12 and B + C = 1/15 ⇒ B = 1/12 − 3x = 1/15 − 2x ⇒ x = 1/60. A alone = 1/(3x) = 1/(3×1/60) = 24 days.

questions.question: Three pipes P, Q and R can fill a tank in 10, 15 and 20 hours respectively. P is opened at 8 AM, Q at 9 AM and R at 10 AM. At what time will the tank be full?

questions.explanation: Work done by 8–9 AM = 1/10. Work done by 9–10 AM = (1/10 + 1/15) = 1/6. Work done together after 10 AM = (1/10 + 1/15 + 1/20) = 13/60. Remaining = 1 − (1/10 + 1/6) = 11/30. Time = (11/30)/(13/60) = 22/13 h ≈ 1 h 42 min after 10 AM → 11 : 48 AM.
